images.filename: 75 ct diamond Lombok treasure Museum Volkenkunde Leiden.jpg
images.caption: A 75 carat diamond at the Museum Volkenkunde (Ethnological Museum) in Leiden. this jewel was taken, together with 230 kg of gold, 7000 kg of silver and three chests of jewels and precious stones, from the royal treasury of Lombok after a Dutch invasion in 1894. Only part of the treasure was handed back to Indonesia in 1977.
images.alt: A 75 carat diamond at the Museum Volkenkunde (Ethnological Museum) in Leiden. this jewel was taken, together with 230 kg of gold, 7000 kg of silver and three chests of jewels and precious stones, from the royal treasury of Lombok after a Dutch invasion in 1894. Only part of the treasure was handed back to Indonesia in 1977.
